name: auryn-compose
summary: Docker Compose plugin for Auryn (deployment & infrastructure tier, ADR 0007). Parses docker-compose files into Service nodes (RUNS_IMAGE the shared Image hub, DEPENDS_ON other services). A `deploy-compose` enrichment links each service that has both `build:` and `image:` to the Dockerfile stage it builds (`build.target`, else the final stage) with BUILDS_IMAGE, marking the image resolved/internal; the stages come from auryn-docker, so install both. Depends on auryn-core and PyYAML.
